notes.title: Do you have SALT? is available now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=m-9Dj_UuOmc;full][/previewyoutube]
We have great news! Our game [b]Do you have SALT?[/b] has been released on Steam! 

In this Visual Novel, A girl named Anastasia, who lives in an old multi-story building, decides to leave her apartment. She goes to get some salt to ask her neighbors and find a treasure hidden in this house. But what kind of treasure is this, and is it worth looking for?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2975870
